name: command
title: Command Palette
description: A modal command menu with a search box, grouped actions and a shortcut key at the right of each row. Typing filters the list down and the first match is highlighted.
use: A keyboard-first app wants one searchable menu for navigation, actions and shortcuts.
avoid: It is a modal dialog that needs the Dialog component, and on touch it offers no gesture to open itself.
a11y: The dialog has a hidden title and description and full keyboard control; focus rings are dropped in favour of a row highlight. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark grey rounded panel on black, topped by a search icon and a placeholder line. Below, two small grey group labels, Suggestions and Settings, separate six white rows, each ending in a tiny outlined shortcut key; the active row is slightly lighter.
behaves: Typing in the search field filters the rows live; one frame shows a single Billing result under Settings. The first match is selected by default, arrow keys move the highlight, and choosing an item or pressing escape closes the dialog.
customise: Compose your own items, groups, separators and shortcuts as children, pass a placeholder to CommandInput, and set the dialog title and description. Styling comes through className.
weight: light: A small dialog with a search input and six rows; filtering is local.
